{{Quote|What can you see? On a world called ''Mechis III?'' Can you see what they will do? Can you see ''them?'' Crafting a ''new body'' for their old leader…and restoring his ''mind.''|The [[Eye of Webbish Bog]], to [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], on the rebuilding of [[Ajax Sigma]]|<ref name="Revelations 1">[[Revelations (2022) 1|''Revelations'' (2022) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Mechis III''', also known as '''Mechis''', was a small [[planetoid]] vital to the [[Techno Union]]. It was defended by a mix of [[starship]]s from member corporations and design firms such as [[SoroSuub Corporation]].

==Description==
A small [[planetoid]],<ref name="The Book">{{StoryCite|story=The Book of Ajax|book=Dark Droids: D-Squad 1}}</ref> Mechis III was a terrestrial world<ref name="Revelations 1" /> located in the [[Mechis system]] in the [[Inner Rim Territories]]. Situated at the coordinates [[Standard Galactic Grid|L-14]] on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> it lay along the [[Corellian Trade Spine]] between the<ref name="TFABG" /> planets<ref name="Bounty Hunters 29">[[Bounty Hunters 29|''Bounty Hunters'' 29]]</ref><ref name="Givin DB">{{Databank|givin|Givin}}</ref> [[Bestine IV]] and [[Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="TFABG" /> It also laid just off the [[Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="Scarif">{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], the [[Techno Union]], a corporation tied to the Separatists, controlled Mechis III. To protect Mechis and its other vital worlds from [[Republic Military|Republic forces]], the Techno Union provided a mix of overstock and prototype [[starship]]s and [[starfighter]]s its own member corporations and design firms like the [[SoroSuub Corporation]], as well as deploying some [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports]].<ref name="RotS" /> The [[Sullustan Home Guard]] operated on Mechis III.<ref name="OSWM 122">{{GermanFanCite|122|Database}}</ref>

[[File:ArmedToTheTeeth-SoH.png|thumb|right|300px|IG-88B in combat on Mechis III]]
In either [[3 ABY]] or [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of [[Revelations (2022) 1|''Revelations'' 1]] take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], the [[neural core]] of [[Ajax Sigma]], a [[droid]] insurgent that had been [[Battle on Kligson's Moon|destroyed]] by [[Jedi Knight]]s during the [[High Republic Era]], was brought to Mechis III by his followers. The followers rebuilt and reactivated Sigma over at an operating table.<ref name="Revelations 1" /> At one point,<ref name="AA">{{FFGTCG|set=Desperate Circumstances|cardname=Automated Assassin|link=alliances-cycle/desperate-circumstances/automated-assassin-r2031}}</ref> the incredibly-well armed<ref name="SparkofHope">{{Destiny|set=Spark of Hope|cardname=Armed to the Teeth|link=https://swdestinydb.com/card/11042}}</ref> [[IG-series assassin droid]] [[IG-88B]]<ref name="IG-88B">{{Armada|set=Rebellion in the Rim|cardname=IG-88B}}</ref> fought on Mechis, firing [[blaster]]s in two directions<ref name="AA" /> and remaining focused on causing fatalities.<ref name="FocusedonKill">{{SWIA|set=Jawa Scavenger Villain Pack|cardname=Focused on the Kill|link=https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Focused_on_the_Kill}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mechis III was first mentioned, as Mechis, in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], a [[2016]] supplement to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' series of ''Star Wars'' roleplaying products.<ref name="TFABG" /> In a piece by artist [[Nasrul Hakim]]<ref name="NasrulArt">{{ArtStation|username=nerdiesid|url=projects/A9lxE5|name=Nasrul Hakim|text=Star Wars Alliance - 01|quote=Work done for one of the Star Wars series card}}</ref> the world was later pictured in the [[Jawa Scavenger Villain Pack]] card "Focused on the Kill,"<ref name="FocusedonKill" /> although the location was not identified as being Mechis until the art was reused in the card "Automated Assassin," which was released as part of Fantasy Flight Games' ''[[Star Wars: The Card Game]]'' in the pack ''[[Desperate Circumstances]]'' in [[2017]]. "Automated Assassin" also first identified the planet by its full name of Mechis III.<ref name="AA" /> Mechis III originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], which was by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>
